```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(DT)
library(yaml)

cfg        <- yaml::read_yaml(file.path("metadata/project_config.yaml"))
output_dir <- file.path(getwd(), cfg$paths$output_dir, cfg$paths$run_label)
subset_label <- "Full cohort"
source(file.path("analysis/_chapter_template.R"))
```

---

# Data Loading

Raw 10x CellRanger output read and merged into a single object.
Cell counts before any quality filtering.

```{r raw-cell-table}
raw_summary <- read.csv(chapter_table("raw_cell_summary.csv"),
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
total_row <- data.frame(
  sample  = "**Total**",
  n_cells = sum(raw_summary$n_cells),
  n_genes = raw_summary$n_genes[1]
)
DT::datatable(
  rbind(raw_summary, total_row),
  caption  = "Raw cell and gene counts per sample (pre-QC)",
  rownames = FALSE,
  colnames = c("Sample", "Cells (raw)", "Genes in matrix"),
  options  = list(pageLength = 12, dom = "t")
)
```

# QC Metrics

## Violin plots (pre-filter)

```{r qc-violin}
#| fig-cap: "QC distributions per sample before filtering."

knitr::include_graphics(chapter_figure("qc_violin_prefilter.png"))
```

## Per-sample summary statistics

```{r qc-stats-table}
qc_stats <- read.csv(chapter_table("qc_stats_summary.csv"),
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
DT::datatable(
  qc_stats,
  caption  = "Median (IQR) of QC metrics per sample, pre-filter",
  rownames = FALSE,
  options  = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE, dom = "t")
) |> DT::formatRound(columns = 2:ncol(qc_stats), digits = 2)
```

---

# Filtering

## Thresholds applied

Cells were retained if they satisfied **all** of the following:

- `percent.mt` ≤ `r cfg$qc$mito_percent_max`%
- `nFeature_RNA` ∈ [`r cfg$qc$nFeature_min`, `r cfg$qc$nFeature_max`]
- `percent.rp` ∈ [`r cfg$qc$ribo_percent_min`%, `r cfg$qc$ribo_percent_max`%]
- `percent.hb` ≤ `r cfg$qc$hb_percent_max`%

Genes expressed in fewer than `r cfg$qc$min_cells_per_gene` cells were removed.

HTO classes removed (deMULTIplex2): **`r if (length(unlist(cfg$qc$remove_hto_classes)) > 0) paste(unlist(cfg$qc$remove_hto_classes), collapse = ", ") else "none"`**.

scDblFinder doublets: **`r if (cfg$qc$remove_doublets) "removed" else "retained"`**.

## Cell counts before and after filtering

```{r filtering-table}
qc_sum <- read.csv(chapter_table("qc_summary.csv"),
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
qc_sum$pct_retained <- round(100 * qc_sum$cells_after / qc_sum$cells_before, 1)
totals <- data.frame(
  sample        = "**Total**",
  cells_before  = sum(qc_sum$cells_before),
  cells_after   = sum(qc_sum$cells_after),
  cells_removed = sum(qc_sum$cells_removed),
  pct_retained  = round(100 * sum(qc_sum$cells_after) / sum(qc_sum$cells_before), 1)
)
DT::datatable(
  rbind(qc_sum, totals),
  caption  = "Cell counts before and after QC filtering",
  rownames = FALSE,
  colnames = c("Sample", "Cells (raw)", "Cells (filtered)", "Removed", "% retained"),
  options  = list(pageLength = 12, dom = "t")
)
```

## Doublet detection

```{r doublet-table}
doublet_sum <- read.csv(chapter_table("doublet_summary.csv"),
                        stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
DT::datatable(
  doublet_sum,
  caption  = "Doublet calls per sample (scDblFinder, post-QC cells)",
  rownames = FALSE,
  colnames = c("Sample", "Singlets", "Doublets", "Doublet rate (%)"),
  options  = list(pageLength = 12, dom = "t")
) |> DT::formatRound(columns = "doublet_rate_pct", digits = 2)
```
